rows.name: Path
rows.value: abbrev Path (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ

rows.name: prefixSum
rows.value:
def prefixSum (a : Path n) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k), a i

rows.name: prefixSquares
rows.value:
def prefixSquares (a : Path n) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k), (a i) ^ 2

rows.name: energy
rows.value: def energy (a : Path n) : ℝ := ∑ i, (a i) ^ 2

rows.name: truncationF
rows.value: def truncationF (z : ℝ) : ℝ := z ^ 2 * min |z| 1

rows.name: normalizedEndpoint
rows.value:
def normalizedEndpoint (a : Path n) : ℝ :=
  if energy a = 0 then 0 else prefixSum a n / Real.sqrt (energy a)

rows.name: BridgeTime
rows.value: abbrev BridgeTime := unitInterval

rows.name: BridgeNoise
rows.value: abbrev BridgeNoise := {g : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) // g 0 = 0 ∧ g 1 = 0}

rows.name: bridgePath
strictUpper
rows.value:
def strictUpper (a y T z : ℝ) : Set BridgeNoise :=
  {g | ∀ t : BridgeTime, bridgePath y T z g t < a}

rows.name: strictLower
rows.value:
def strictLower (a y T z : ℝ) : Set BridgeNoise :=
  {g | ∀ t : BridgeTime, -a < bridgePath y T z g t}

rows.name: strictInterval
rows.value:
def strictInterval (a y T z : ℝ) : Set BridgeNoise :=
  strictUpper a y T z ∩ strictLower a y T z

rows.name: upperCompletion
rows.value:
def upperCompletion (P : Measure BridgeNoise) (a y T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P.real (strictUpper a y T z)

rows.name: lowerCompletion
rows.value:
def lowerCompletion (P : Measure BridgeNoise) (a y T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P.real (strictLower a y T z)

rows.name: intervalCompletion
rows.value:
def intervalCompletion (P : Measure BridgeNoise) (a y T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P.real (strictInterval a y T z)

rows.name: leftWeight
rows.value:
def leftWeight : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) :=
  ⟨fun t => 1 - (t : ℝ), by fun_prop⟩

rows.name: rightWeight
rows.value:
def rightWeight : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) :=
  ⟨fun t => (t : ℝ), by fun_prop⟩

bridgeNoise

def bridgeNoise {Ω : Type*} (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) : BridgeNoise :=

rows.value:
def bridgeLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

rows.name: CompletionParameters
rows.value: abbrev CompletionParameters := ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ

rows.name: imageA
rows.value: def imageA (a y z m : ℝ) : ℝ := 8 * m ^ 2 * a ^ 2 + 4 * m * a * (z - y)

rows.name: imageB
rows.value: def imageB (a y z m : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 * (y + (2 * m + 1) * a) * (z + (2 * m + 1) * a)

rows.name: spatialTailBlock
rows.value:
def spatialTailBlock (j : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageA a w z ((n : ℤ) + 2 : ℤ) / T)) y +
    iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageA a w z (-((n : ℤ) + 2) : ℤ) / T)) y -
    iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageB a w z ((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) / T)) y -
    iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageB a w z (-((n : ℤ) + 2) : ℤ) / T)) y

rows.name: spatialTailSum
rows.value:
def spatialTailSum (j : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, spatialTailBlock j a z T y n

rows.name: finiteSpatialImages
rows.value:
def finiteSpatialImages (j : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageA a w z 0 / T)) y +
    iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageA a w z 1 / T)) y +
    iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageA a w z (-1) / T)) y -
    iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageB a w z 0 / T)) y -
    iteratedDeriv j (fun w => Real.exp (-imageB a w z (-1) / T)) y

rows.name: imageCandidateSpatial
rows.value:
def imageCandidateSpatial (j : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  finiteSpatialImages j a z T y + spatialTailSum j a z T y

rows.name: intervalImageCandidate
rows.value:
def intervalImageCandidate (a z T y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  imageCandidateSpatial 0 a z T y

rows.name: sourceIntervalCompletion
slopeTime
rows.value: def slopeTime (u v T : ℝ) : ℝ := (2 * v / T) * Real.exp (-2 * u * v / T)

rows.name: upperReflection
rows.value:
def upperReflection (a y T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 - Real.exp (-2 * (a - y) * (a - z) / T)

rows.name: lowerReflection
rows.value:
def lowerReflection (a y T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 - Real.exp (-2 * (a + y) * (a + z) / T)

rows.name: standardNormalDensity
rows.value:
noncomputable def standardNormalDensity (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x

rows.name: standardNormalTail
rows.value:
noncomputable def standardNormalTail (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=

rows.name: truncationBudget
rows.value:
noncomputable def truncationBudget (ν : Measure ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (n : ℝ) * ∫ z : ℝ, truncationF ((1 + t) * z) ∂ν

rows.value: abbrev LabelPerm (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

rows.name: PrefixMeasurable
rows.value:
def PrefixMeasurable {n : ℕ} {α : Sort*} (r : ℕ)
    (f : LabelPerm n → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ τ : LabelPerm n,
    (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < r → σ i = τ i) → f σ = f τ

rows.name: remainingSum
rows.value:
def remainingSum {n : ℕ} (a : Shao.Path n) (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) : ℝ :=
  Shao.prefixSum a n - Shao.prefixSum (Spitzer.reorder a σ) r

rows.name: remainingEnergy
uniformMean
rows.value:
def uniformMean {n : ℕ} (f : LabelPerm n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ σ : LabelPerm n, f σ) / (Fintype.card (LabelPerm n) : ℝ)

rows.name: compensationCoefficient
rows.value: def compensationCoefficient (b d T : ℝ) : ℝ := b - b ^ 2 * d / T

rows.name: IsRevealStoppingRank
rows.value:
def IsRevealStoppingRank {n : ℕ} (ν : LabelPerm n → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ σ, ν σ ≤ n) ∧
  ∀ (r : ℕ) (σ τ : LabelPerm n),
    (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < r → σ i = τ i) → (ν σ ≤ r ↔ ν τ ≤ r)

rows.name: energyCutoff
rows.value:
def energyCutoff {n : ℕ} (a : Shao.Path n) (H : ℝ)
    (σ : LabelPerm n) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact if hex : ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ n ∧ remainingEnergy a r σ < H then Nat.find hex else n

rows.name: MonitoredDomain
rows.value:
inductive MonitoredDomain : Type
  | upper
  | lower
  | interval
  deriving DecidableEq

rows.name: Interior
rows.value:
def Interior (J : MonitoredDomain) (w y : ℝ) : Prop :=
  match J with
  | .upper => y < w
  | .lower => -w < y
  | .interval => -w < y ∧ y < w

rows.name: eventCompletionKernel
rows.value:
def eventCompletionKernel (J : MonitoredDomain)
    (P : Measure Shao.C2.BridgeDomination.BridgeNoise) : BridgeKernel :=
  match J with
  | .upper => fun p => Shao.C2.BridgeDomination.upperCompletion P
      p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2
  | .lower => fun p => Shao.C2.BridgeDomination.lowerCompletion P
      p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2
  | .interval => fun p => Shao.C2.BridgeDomination.intervalCompletion P
      p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2

rows.name: actualWall
rows.value:
def actualWall {n : ℕ} (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x * Real.sqrt (Shao.energy a)

rows.name: completionExt
rows.value:
def completionExt (J : MonitoredDomain) (F : BridgeKernel)
    (w y T z : ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if 0 < w ∧ Interior J w y ∧ Interior J w z then
    if 0 < T then F (w, y, T, z)
    else if T = 0 ∧ y = z then 1 else 0
  else 0

rows.name: sourceAlive
rows.value:
def sourceAlive {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (a : Shao.Path n)
    (x : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) : Prop :=
  0 < Shao.energy a ∧
    Interior J (actualWall a x) (Shao.prefixSum a n) ∧
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r →
      Interior J (actualWall a x) (Shao.prefixSum (Spitzer.reorder a σ) k)

rows.name: sourceValue
rows.value:
def sourceValue {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (F : BridgeKernel)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if sourceAlive J a x r σ then
    completionExt J F (actualWall a x)
      (Shao.prefixSum (Spitzer.reorder a σ) r)
      (remainingEnergy a r σ) (Shao.prefixSum a n)
  else 0

rows.name: localRemainder
rows.value:
def localRemainder (J : MonitoredDomain) (F G : BridgeKernel)
    (w y T z b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  completionExt J F w (y + b) (T - b ^ 2) z - F (w, y, T, z) -
    compensationCoefficient b (z - y) T * G (w, y, T, z)

rows.name: sourceDerivativeWeight
rows.value:
def sourceDerivativeWeight {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (G : BridgeKernel)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if sourceAlive J a x r σ ∧ 0 < remainingEnergy a r σ then
    G (actualWall a x, Shao.prefixSum (Spitzer.reorder a σ) r,
      remainingEnergy a r σ, Shao.prefixSum a n)
  else 0

rows.name: sourceRemainder
rows.value:
def sourceRemainder {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (F G : BridgeKernel)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if hr : r < n then
    if sourceAlive J a x r σ ∧ 0 < remainingEnergy a r σ then
      localRemainder J F G (actualWall a x)
        (Shao.prefixSum (Spitzer.reorder a σ) r)
        (remainingEnergy a r σ) (Shao.prefixSum a n) (a (σ ⟨r, hr⟩))
    else 0
  else 0

rows.name: stoppedRemainderSum
rows.value:
def stoppedRemainderSum {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (F G : BridgeKernel)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) (ν : LabelPerm n → ℕ)
    (σ : LabelPerm n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r ∈ Finset.range n, if r < ν σ then sourceRemainder J F G a x r σ else 0

rows.name: KernelBounds
rows.value:
structure KernelBounds (J : MonitoredDomain) (F G : BridgeKernel) (C : ℝ) : Prop where
  nonnegC : 0 ≤ C
  completion_bounds : ∀ w y T z : ℝ,
    0 < w → 0 < T → Interior J w y → Interior J w z →
      0 ≤ F (w, y, T, z) ∧ F (w, y, T, z) ≤ 1
  derivative_bound : ∀ w y T z : ℝ,
    0 < w → 0 < T → Interior J w y → Interior J w z →
      |G (w, y, T, z)| ≤ C / Real.sqrt T * (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T)

rows.name: PermutationInvariant
rows.value:
def PermutationInvariant {n : ℕ} (m : Shao.Path n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Shao.Path n) (σ : LabelPerm n), m (Spitzer.reorder a σ) = m a

rows.name: uniformPermutationLaw
rows.value:
def uniformPermutationLaw (n : ℕ) : Measure (LabelPerm n) :=
  ((Fintype.card (LabelPerm n) : ENNReal)⁻¹) • Measure.count

rows.name: projectionIncrement
rows.value:
def projectionIncrement (J : MonitoredDomain) (w y b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  match J with
  | .upper => if w ≤ y + b then w - y else b
  | .lower => if y + b ≤ -w then -w - y else b
  | .interval => if w ≤ y + b then w - y else
      if y + b ≤ -w then -w - y else b

rows.name: localRetainedRemainder
rows.value:
def localRetainedRemainder (J : MonitoredDomain) (F G : BridgeKernel)
    (w y T z b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if 0 < T ∧ b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2 then
    localRemainder J F G w y T z (projectionIncrement J w y b)
  else localRemainder J F G w y T z b

rows.name: localSeparatedOvershoot
rows.value:
def localSeparatedOvershoot (J : MonitoredDomain) (G : BridgeKernel)
    (w y T z b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if 0 < T ∧ b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2 then
    -(b - projectionIncrement J w y b) *
      (1 - (b + projectionIncrement J w y b) * (z - y) / T) *
      G (w, y, T, z)
  else 0

rows.name: sourceRetainedRemainder
rows.value:
def sourceRetainedRemainder {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (F G : BridgeKernel)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) (ν : LabelPerm n → ℕ)
    (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) : ℝ :=
  if hr : r < n then
    if r < ν σ ∧ sourceAlive J a x r σ ∧ 0 < remainingEnergy a r σ then
      localRetainedRemainder J F G (actualWall a x)
        (Shao.prefixSum (Spitzer.reorder a σ) r)
        (remainingEnergy a r σ) (Shao.prefixSum a n) (a (σ ⟨r, hr⟩))
    else 0
  else 0

rows.name: sourceSeparatedOvershoot
rows.value:
def sourceSeparatedOvershoot {n : ℕ} (J : MonitoredDomain) (G : BridgeKernel)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (x : ℝ) (ν : LabelPerm n → ℕ)
    (r : ℕ) (σ : LabelPerm n) : ℝ :=
  if hr : r < n then
    if r < ν σ ∧ sourceAlive J a x r σ ∧ 0 < remainingEnergy a r σ then
      localSeparatedOvershoot J G (actualWall a x)
        (Shao.prefixSum (Spitzer.reorder a σ) r)
        (remainingEnergy a r σ) (Shao.prefixSum a n) (a (σ ⟨r, hr⟩))
    else 0
  else 0

rows.name: halflineDerivative
rows.value:
def halflineDerivative (J : MonitoredDomain) : BridgeKernel :=
  match J with
  | .upper => fun p => -Shao.C2.HalfLineMixedProfiles.slopeTime
      (p.1 - p.2.1) (p.1 - p.2.2.2) p.2.2.1
  | .lower => fun p => Shao.C2.HalfLineMixedProfiles.slopeTime
      (p.1 + p.2.1) (p.1 + p.2.2.2) p.2.2.1
  | .interval => fun _ => 0

rows.name: HalflineReflectionIdentities
rows.value:
def HalflineReflectionIdentities (Q : Measure BridgeNoise) : Prop :=
  (∀ w y T z : ℝ, 0 < w → 0 < T → y < w → z < w →
    upperCompletion Q w y T z = Shao.C2.HalfLineReflectionFormula.upperReflection w y T z) ∧
  (∀ w y T z : ℝ, 0 < w → 0 < T → -w < y → -w < z →
    lowerCompletion Q w y T z = Shao.C2.HalfLineReflectionFormula.lowerReflection w y T z)

rows.name: intervalDerivative
rows.value:
def intervalDerivative (Q : Measure BridgeNoise) : BridgeKernel := fun p =>
  if 0 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2.2.1 ∧ |p.2.1| < p.1 ∧ |p.2.2.2| < p.1 then
    deriv (fun y : ℝ => eventCompletionKernel .interval Q
      (p.1, y, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2)) p.2.1
  else 0

rows.name: brownianUnitPath
rows.value:
def brownianUnitPath {Ω : Type*} (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    C(unitInterval, ℝ) :=
  if hc : Continuous (fun u : unitInterval => B (unitTime T u) ω) then
    ⟨fun u => B (unitTime T u) ω, hc⟩
  else 0
